Production best-of-64 — 50 groups, equal-weight reward

What this is (for dummies). from the running 40-emotions × 100-prompts × 64-takes production run (moss-local 48 kHz, Sidon-restored audio only), here are 48 groups — 2 per emotion across 24 emotions — each showing the single best take out of its 64. ranking uses the equal-weight reward:

reward = invWER × ( norm(target emotion) + norm(vocal-burst blend) + norm(genuineness) )

all three quality signals count the same, then multiplied by word accuracy. normalisation is min-max over all 143,746 takes scored so far. scores shown: the target-emotion score (Empathic-Insight-Plus head for the emotion the prompt asked for), blend, genuineness, invWER (1.00 = every word correct), arousal, and volume (rms dB).
